name: io.github.info-arnav/unlocalhost
description: Deploy localhost to a private, authenticated link from your AI coding agent.

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the unlocalhost instance to talk to. Defaults to the hosted instance. Set this to point the tools at your own self hosted deployment.
environmentVariables.name: UNLOCALHOST_URL

environmentVariables.description: API token. Normally written by the unlocalhost_login tool after you approve the device in a browser, so you should not need to set this by hand.
environmentVariables.name: UNLOCALHOST_TOKEN
